results.summary: The task required building a single-file Python CLI freight-bill audit tool (/app/audit.py) that processes ocean-freight invoices, contracts, terminal logs, correspondence, and FX data according to a detailed policy.md audit procedure, producing audit.json, landed_cost.csv, and per-run JSON files while persisting state across sequential payment runs. The agent (Codex/gpt-5.6-sol) explored the data, legacy tool, and historical batches, implemented the tool, validated it against four historical months (reproducing all 52 historical AP ledger postings exactly), handled edge cases like OCR for image-only invoices, and ran all payment runs in /app/data in order. The verifier's pytest suite reported 46 passed and 2 skipped (the 2 skips were intentional, for trap cases not planted in the given batch), yielding a full reward. The agent finished in about 26 minutes of execution time, well within the 8-hour budget, and there is no evidence of accessing test files, solution directories, or reward files.
